title: Transcenta Inks Licensing Deal with EirGenix to Advance Continuous Biomanufacturing
summary: Transcenta granted EirGenix a non-exclusive license to use its HiCB platform, including continuous perfusion and integrated hybrid continuous purification process technologies, along with process documentation, expertise, and regulatory support packages.The postTranscenta Inks Licensing Deal with EirGenix to Advance Continuous Biomanufacturingappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
